comment: Fixed prompt set for Qwen3.6-35B serving validation (#77 Path-1). Greedy, enable_thinking=false for assertable outputs except the last. 'expect' = substring that must appear in content (case-insensitive). True HF bf16 reference parity is NOT possible on this fleet (35B bf16 needs ~70GB+); this set gates coherence + factual correctness + cross-path (ov-genai vs qwen36-moe staged) consistency instead.

prompts.content: What is the capital of France? Answer with one word.
What is 17 + 25? Answer with just the number.
Write a Python function that returns the square of a number. Code only.
What gas do plants absorb from the atmosphere during photosynthesis? One short answer.
Is 97 a prime number? Explain briefly.
